notes: Shurayh speaks («قال أتيت عائشة أسألها»); «فسألناه فقال» makes Ali the answerer whose words are the saying, so he is the last link (rule 6). He is named inside Aisha's words («بابن أبي طالب»), hence a narrator.
Aisha's advice is scene, not a route. «قال وكان سفيان إذا ذكر عمرا أثنى عليه» is a remark by a transmitter: left out.
